Framework

AI Experience Architecture™

A framework for designing intelligent enterprise products that people understand, trust, and confidently adopt.

01Signal Architecture
02Human Oversight Design
03Agentic Design Systems
04Trust Architecture
05AI Governance UX

What It Is

AI Experience Architecture™ is the discipline of designing AI systems that are legible, trustworthy, and governable by the humans who depend on them. It is the practice layer between AI capability and human understanding — the structural decisions that determine whether an AI product earns trust or destroys it.

Why It Matters

AI is being deployed into enterprise products faster than it can be designed. The result: products that make decisions users don't understand, with controls they can't find, in systems they can't trust. AI Experience Architecture™ addresses this gap — not as a feature, but as a structural discipline.

Core Principles

What the framework believes.

Systems Before Screens

The interface is the surface. The architecture is the substance. Design the system first, the screen second.

Trust Is a Design Material

Trust is not a feature to add at the end. It is a material — like color or spacing — considered in every decision.

Governance Is a Design Problem

Who decides how the AI behaves? Design that answer before it is made for you.

Human-in-the-Loop Is a Pattern

Oversight is not a disclaimer. It is a designed moment — with a clear interface, a clear action, and a clear consequence.

Experience Layers

Five pillars. One architecture.

The framework is organized across five experience layers — each addressing a different dimension of how humans and AI systems build shared understanding. Together, they form the structural architecture of a trustworthy AI product.

01

Signal Architecture

Designing how AI systems communicate what they know, what they inferred, and how confident they are — before the human has to ask.

02

Human Oversight Design

Defining the moments where humans must review, correct, or approve AI decisions — and designing those moments to be fast, clear, and trustworthy.

03

Agentic Design Systems

Building the tokens, components, and patterns that encode AI-specific states into the design system — so agentic behavior is consistent, not improvised.

04

Trust Architecture

Structuring how trust is earned, maintained, and repaired across an AI product — at the level of interaction, interface, and system.

05

AI Governance UX

Designing the interfaces through which organizations configure, audit, and govern AI behavior — making governance legible to the people responsible for it.

Applications

Where the framework applies.

AI Experience Architecture™ applies wherever AI makes decisions that affect people — and wherever humans need to understand, trust, or override those decisions.

Enterprise AI Products

SaaS platforms where AI drives decisions, recommendations, or automation that users depend on daily.

Agentic Systems

AI agents that act on behalf of users — where oversight, intervention, and auditability are foundational requirements.

Clinical Decision Support

Healthcare AI where legibility and human override are regulatory requirements and ethical imperatives.

Financial AI

Risk, underwriting, and advisory systems where explainability is required and trust is the product.

AI-Native Design Systems

Component and pattern libraries built specifically for agentic interfaces — where standard design systems break down.

AI Governance Platforms

Internal tools for configuring, auditing, and governing AI behavior across an organization.
